name: NR hidden object state: minimal discriminating evidence chain v0.1
claim: H1: feasible action-observation histories improve prediction beyond matched current observations and can be compressed and recursively updated over a declared action class. H2 is separate: the information improves a consequential decision before ordinary feedback supplies equivalent information.
unit_of_analysis: Parent history-generating block conditional on one fixed plant for the initial diagnostic; all pair members, future forks, frames and training seeds are dependent within that block. Later material claims require independent specimen or batch clusters.

target.extension: C: calibrated belief if unresolved uncertainty changes decisions

datasets.role: Code audit and evidence reconstruction; not new final testing
Spatial 2D continuum histories with independent sensor noise and physical replay
Articulated 3D closed-loop robot episodes with validated bidirectional contact
Real calibration and later robot trials

splits.name: calibration
splits.leakage_check: No shared history or specimen test labels; model identification recorded separately

splits.name: independent_pilot
splits.held_out: Independent parent blocks not used in final estimates
splits.leakage_check: Freeze gates, action library, margins and later power before fresh final generation

splits.name: train
splits.leakage_check: Hash parent manifests; never split overlapping windows or branches

splits.name: validation
splits.leakage_check: Select models, hyperparameters and one primary contrast without final outcomes

splits.name: initial_2d_test
splits.held_out: 64 matched-pair blocks plus 64 natural-history blocks, all fresh
splits.leakage_check: Freeze generation without future-effect filtering; never treat this planning n as powered robot confirmation

splits.name: later_robot_confirmation
splits.held_out: Fresh groups after an independent robot pilot
splits.leakage_check: Prospective precision/power calculation and separate transfer groups before final access

baselines.name: M2 full-history classical and named learned initializer
M3 recursive representation
controlled_variables: shared predictor or encoder-law factorial comparison

baselines.name: M4 true hidden state with same fitted predictor
controlled_variables: same action library, controller, horizon and law

baselines.name: M5 true state with true law
controlled_variables: separately label removal of both state and model error

baselines.name: tuned reactive controller
controlled_variables: separate native-action result if interfaces differ

metrics.name: X01 paired future-response effect relative to measured error floor
metrics.rationale: Missing information must survive observable matching and physics/numerical checks

metrics.name: X02 predictive loss and history/action sweep
X03 older-history residual predictive gain with interval
metrics.direction: below a meaningful predeclared tolerance for adequacy
metrics.rationale: Require capable probes; nonsignificance alone is inconclusive

metrics.name: X02-X04 CRPS or multivariate energy score plus coverage
metrics.direction: lower proper score with calibrated coverage
metrics.rationale: RMSE cannot test omitted variance or multimodality; otherwise narrow claim to mean prediction

metrics.name: X04 recursive/prefix forecast discrepancy with both scored against truth
metrics.rationale: Agreement between two wrong estimators is insufficient

metrics.name: X05 held-out-action response and action-ranking error
metrics.rationale: Encode once and exclude future realized motion from inputs

metrics.name: X06 full-operation constraint-respecting utility
metrics.rationale: Separate decision evidence from forecast accuracy; include all failures and prefix costs
metrics.utility_definition: UNFROZEN: credible task specification and independent pilot required

metrics.name: X07 shift-specific degradation and adaptation cost
metrics.rationale: Action, shape, material, mechanism and embodiment shifts are distinct

ablations: Elastic no-memory carrier under the same sensing and task
Initial history grid 0/0.05/0.2/0.5/1/3 s for archived modes; recalibrate for new carrier before final access
Ordinary versus informative feasible excitation with probe costs included
Current visible shape/force/channel availability with independent noise
Common observer covariance versus validation-calibrated covariance versus no-innovation diagnostic
State-information reference at decision versus truth-initialized ordinary observer
Encoder versus forward-law factorial if candidate changes both
Natural feedback primary; credible latency sensitivity secondary, never remove feedback solely to favor memory
falsification_criteria: X01 effect vanishes after matching all visible channels or correcting numerical/actuator artifacts: reject missing object-state claim in that regime
Short classical inference matches candidate across declared tests: stop unsupported learned-method necessity claim
Adequate older-history probe adds decision-relevant prediction: reject tested representation sufficiency
Recursive predictions agree but fail held-out outcomes: reject online-state adequacy
No M4 decision advantage after controller/action sensitivity checks: stop action-value claim for this task
Useful reference gap but demonstrably inadequate sensing: change information conditions or maintain belief, not claim neural failure proves impossibility
Existing method matches the proposed problem, deployable information, mechanism and central evidence: stop that novelty claim

statistics.primary_contrasts: one contrast frozen on validation per H1/H2 stage
statistics.resampling: cluster by parent history and first by material instance if multiple histories share it
statistics.binary_ceiling: Report discordant counts and appropriate exact or one-sided bounds; do not infer equivalence from [0,0] bootstrap
statistics.multiplicity: Holm correction for predeclared secondary comparison family
statistics.power: Initial sizes are planning values for route selection; fresh robot confirmation requires independent pilot-based calculation
statistics.failures: retain solver errors, invalid trajectories, timeouts, divergence, cap breaches, drops and missing-data cases with reasons

compute_budget.benchmark_full_sweep: gated on throughput and useful task gap
compute_budget.environment: Existing project Python is CPU-only; dedicated locked simulator environment required

seed_status: Planned initial training seeds; later confirmation targets five if feasible; not independent physical samples
unfrozen_gates: physical specimen and calibrated time scales
artifacts: model checkpoints and complete carried state
execution_order: real robot after simulation gate; coupon calibration may occur earlier
